sourceMetadata.sort_order: approximate grade minimum, then Lexile measure, then grade maximum, then author/title for ties
notes: Word count and Lexile fields were reviewed again; blank Lexile values have been filled with best-available official or estimated measures. Word counts remain in thousands and are rounded for curriculum planning.
For exact edition matching, verify ISBN-specific Lexile and AR data for the school edition before printing student-facing lists.
Publisher is generally original, common, or edition-neutral when a title has many editions.
Historical timeframe uses negative years for BC and null for works whose setting is legendary, fantasy, non-narrative, or not meaningfully historical.
Setting locations are approximate and edition-dependent; anthologies, poems, essays, reference works, myths, and allegories may use broad or non-narrative location labels.
revision_notes: Re-sorted PDF export by approximate grade minimum and Lexile measure.
Added Rikki-Tikki-Tavi by Rudyard Kipling as priority 1 per user request.
Added setting_location to each book for curriculum geography coordination.
Reviewed and filled Lexile measures and revised numerous placeholder word counts; no blank Lexile fields remain.

source_hierarchy: Renaissance Accelerated Reader Bookfinder / TeachingBooks / publisher or library listings when readily available
Canon of Literature v.1.3 PDF values for literary-study works already supplied with K|L values
Public-domain text/page-count estimates and known edition lengths for older works
Best-fit estimated Lexile-equivalent values for poems, anthologies, sermons, essays, and works without a stable official Lexile listing
measurement_revision_summary.caveat: Lexile measures for poetry, anthologies, plays, essays, translations, adaptations, and public-domain classics are especially edition-dependent. Values filled for those categories should be treated as curricular estimates rather than official standardized measures unless an official listing is available for the exact edition used.

onlineVerification.broadCheck: Previous Open Library Search API pass over the original 524-row source file for title/author/publication-year signals; this update imports the user-provided 525-row measurement revision.
onlineVerification.correctionPolicy: Prior deterministic structural fixes and targeted bibliographic corrections are preserved. This update imports revised Lexile and word-count fields from the user-provided measurement file while leaving schoolCanonPriority out of Convex seed args.
